title: Reovirus Plaque Assay
author: Bernardo Mainou
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kghctt6

steps.title: Seed L929 Cells
steps.instruction: Seed 6-well plates with L929 cells in 2 ml complete MEM (Joklik S-MEM supplemented with 5% FBS, 2 mM L-Glutamine, 100 U penicillin/ml, 100 ug streptomycin/ml, and 0.25 mg/ml amphotericin B).

substeps.instruction: For overnight incubation: seed 1×10^6 cells per well and incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2.
For same-day use: seed 2×10^6 cells per well.

steps.title: Prepare Serial Virus Dilutions
steps.instruction: Perform serial dilutions of virus samples using PBS in titer tubes or deep-well 96 well plates.

substeps.instruction: Create 10^-1 dilution by adding 110 ul of sample to 1 ml of PBS.
Mix by pipetting up and down 16 times.
Transfer 110 ul of the mixture to 1 ml of PBS for the 10^-2 dilution.
Continue the process, changing tips between dilutions and ensuring the last sample is mixed.

steps.title: Infect Cells
steps.instruction: Inoculate the seeded cells with the prepared virus dilutions.

substeps.instruction: Label plates and remove the medium from the cells.
Add 110 ul of each virus dilution to two wells per dilution.
Incubate at room temperature for 60 min, rocking every 10 min.

steps.title: Prepare Overlay Components
steps.instruction: Prepare the agar and medium required for the overlay.

substeps.instruction: Melt 2% bacto agar (autoclaved Difco Bacto-agar in water) in a microwave and maintain in a 65°C water bath.
Warm complete 2X Medium 199 (supplemented with 5% FBS, 4 mM L-Glutamine, 200 U penicillin/ml, 200 ug streptomycin/ml, and 0.5 mg/ml amphotericin B) to 37°C.

steps.title: Apply Initial Overlay
steps.instruction: Overlay the infected cells with a 2X199/agar mixture.

substeps.instruction: Combine equal volumes (1:1 v/v) of complete 2X199 and 2% agar.
Mix by swirling and allow to cool slightly.
Carefully overlay each well with 3 ml of the mixture.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 2 days.

steps.title: Feed Overlay
steps.instruction: Apply a second overlay on day 2 post-infection.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 2X199/agar mixture (1:1 v/v).
Overlay each well with 2 ml of the mixture.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 4 days.

steps.title: Stain Plaques
steps.instruction: Stain the cells on day 6 post-infection using neutral red.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a staining mixture using 2X199 media (supplemented only with penicillin, streptomycin, and amphotericin B) mixed with 2% bacto agar.
Add 3 ml of 1% neutral red solution (5 g neutral red in 500 ml water, passed through a 0.45 um filter) for every 100 ml of the mixture.
Allow the mixture to cool slightly and overlay each well with 2 ml.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2 overnight.

steps.title: Read and Calculate Titer
steps.instruction: Quantify the plaques on day 7 post-infection.

substeps.instruction: Count plaques on a light box (acceptable range: 30-300 plaques per well).
Calculate the plaque titer per ml (PFU/ml).
